title: A commit from a checkout behind its moved branch is refused
why: Lane notes-fix-guard-2: three resumed agents kept a stale index or tree after their branch moved (coordinator, 17:07 CST Nov 7). The harm is a silent undo of pushed work.
note: Related steps: one-worktree-per-branch, checkout-b-current-branch. Done check: a red test where a commit from a checkout behind its moved branch is refused, and a fast-forward pull still passes. Absorbs proposed steps one-branch-one-worktree (lane past-ruling-on-send) and one-branch-per-writer (lane reviewer-no-session-tools), coordinator 18:19 CST Nov 7. Incident: a lane ran three writer agents in parallel on one branch, each in its own worktree; two hit stale indexes after the branch moved, and those indexes staged a reversal of hooks/guard.py (both caught before commit). Add a red test where a commit whose index differs from HEAD's tree beyond the staged paths is refused or warned.
